name: vibe-techdesign
title_zh: 把 MVP 技术选型变成一张可执行的设计图
tagline_zh: 当你纠结“该用什么栈、怎么搭”时，它把架构、依赖、风险一次性摊开成文档，省掉你反复找资料、问 AI 的来回拉扯。
tagline_en: Stuck on stack choices? It turns architecture, dependencies, and risks into one clear spec—no more back-and-forth.
desc_en: Create a Technical Design Document for your MVP. Use when the user wants to plan architecture, choose tech stack, or says "plan technical design", "choose tech stack", or "how should I build this".
why_zh: 不是泛泛给建议，而是按你的 MVP 目标强制输出结构化 TDD：先定边界，再选组件，最后列风险。
why_en: It doesn't just suggest—it forces a structured TDD: scope first, then components, then risks. The order is fixed, so you end.
limit_zh: 只服务 MVP 阶段的技术设计，不覆盖已有系统的重构、性能调优或迁移方案；输出是文档不是代码，拿到后仍需自己写实现。
limit_en: For MVP tech design only—no refactoring, tuning, or migration plans. Output is a spec, not code; you still write the implementation yourself.
